# Skills Review and Polish

> Repo for analyzing and fixing AI customization docs like
> `SKILL.md`, `*.instructions.md`, `*.prompt.md`, `*.agent.md`,
> and `AGENTS.md`.

This entry point summarizes the main docs, engine code, and MCP
automation path.

## Documentation

- [README.md](README.md): Start here for project overview and setup.
- [docs/DEVELOPMENT-STANDARDS.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT-STANDARDS.md):
  Coding standards and safety guidance.
- [docs/GIT-WORKFLOW.md](docs/GIT-WORKFLOW.md): Git hooks and test flow.
- [docs/MULTIPLIER-ACCESS.md](docs/MULTIPLIER-ACCESS.md): Cost multiplier
  notes for safe-tier model use.
- [docs/VSCODE-LM-STREAMING-FIX.md](docs/VSCODE-LM-STREAMING-FIX.md):
  VS Code LM streaming notes.
- [docs/plan/PROGRESS.md](docs/plan/PROGRESS.md): Current status and plan.
- [docs/plan/LEARNINGS.md](docs/plan/LEARNINGS.md): Hard-won lessons from analyzer tuning.
- [docs/plan/MCP-IMPROVEMENT-PLAN.md](docs/plan/MCP-IMPROVEMENT-PLAN.md): MCP improvement plan (all waves complete).
- [docs/plan/20260609-gilfoyle-review-remediation/plan.yaml](docs/plan/20260609-gilfoyle-review-remediation/plan.yaml): Gilfoyle review remediation plan (25 issues fixed).
- [docs/plan/GILFOYLE-REVIEW-2026-06-09.md](docs/plan/GILFOYLE-REVIEW-2026-06-09.md): Fresh Gilfoyle code review findings.

## Architecture and Core Code

- [src/core/index.ts](src/core/index.ts): Engine orchestration.
- [src/core/types.ts](src/core/types.ts): Shared types and config.
- [src/core/acceptedFindings.ts](src/core/acceptedFindings.ts): Per-file accepted findings store.
- [src/core/logger.ts](src/core/logger.ts): Structured logging with log levels.
- [src/core/prompts.ts](src/core/prompts.ts): Prompt loading from .md files.
- [src/core/prompts/](src/core/prompts/): Editable .md prompts for all 8 waves.
- [src/pricing.ts](src/pricing.ts): Live model pricing fetcher with static fallback.
- [src/extension.ts](src/extension.ts): VS Code activation and commands.
- [src/providers/vscodeLmProvider.ts](src/providers/vscodeLmProvider.ts):
  Copilot-backed provider path.
- [src/providers/externalProvider.ts](src/providers/externalProvider.ts):
  OpenRouter and GitHub Models providers.
- [src/ui/diagnostics.ts](src/ui/diagnostics.ts): Diagnostic publishing.

## MCP and Automation

- [src/mcp/README.md](src/mcp/README.md): MCP setup, 7-tool reference, client config, and agent workflow.
- [src/mcp/server.ts](src/mcp/server.ts): Headless MCP server entry point with tool registry.
- [src/mcp/server.integration.test.ts](src/mcp/server.integration.test.ts): End-to-end MCP protocol tests.
- [docs/plan/MCP-IMPROVEMENT-PLAN.md](docs/plan/MCP-IMPROVEMENT-PLAN.md): MCP improvement plan (all waves complete).
